title: Coherent systems of abelian sheaves on varying sites
statement: Fix a common smallness universe as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $I$ be a small category and for each $i$ let $\mathcal C_i$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. A varying-site diagram gives, for each $a:j\to i$, a morphism of sites $f_a:\mathcal C_j\to\mathcal C_i$, represented by a continuous functor $u_a:\mathcal C_i\to\mathcal C_j$ whose inverse image on sheaves of sets preserves finite limits. Write $P_a=f_a^{-1}:\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C_i)\to\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C_j)$ for the actual left adjoint of continuous pushforward; it is additive and exact [lem-weil-pbc-site-pullback-abelian-exact]. Coherence data are natural isomorphisms $e_i:P_{\mathrm{id}_i}\cong\mathrm{id}$ and $c_{b,a}:P_{a\circ b}\cong P_b P_a$, satisfying the two unit laws and the associativity law: after the canonical identifications for equality of composed arrows, $e_j P_a\circ c_{\mathrm{id}_j,a}=\mathrm{id}_{P_a}$, $P_a e_i\circ c_{a,\mathrm{id}_i}=\mathrm{id}_{P_a}$, and $c_{c,b}P_a\circ c_{b\circ c,a}=P_c c_{b,a}\circ c_{c,a\circ b}$. A system is a family of abelian sheaves $F_i$ with maps $\phi_a:P_a F_i\to F_j$, with $\phi_{\mathrm{id}_i}=e_i(F_i)$ and $\phi_{a\circ b}=\phi_b\circ P_b(\phi_a)\circ c_{b,a}(F_i)$. A morphism $h:F\to G$ is a family $h_i:F_i\to G_i$ satisfying $\psi_a\circ P_a(h_i)=h_j\circ\phi_a$. The category $\mathscr S$ has these objects and morphisms, with identity and composition computed componentwise (these operations satisfy the category laws). Evaluation $\operatorname{ev}_i:\mathscr S\to\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C_i)$ takes $F$ to $F_i$ and $h$ to $h_i$. Transitions need not be invertible; $I$ need not be filtered or nonempty.
